newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish July reserves rise to 112.4 bln DKK.
newsitem.headline: Danish July reserves rise to 112.4 bln DKK.

text.p: Denmark's foreign exchange reserves rose to 112.4 billion crowns at end-July 1997 from 110.0 billion crowns at end-June, according to the central bank's monthly balance sheet released on Monday.
NOTE - In a statement the central bank said it purchased a net 2.8 billion crowns in foreign currency and the state paid back a net 0.4 billion crowns in foreign loans in July.
Analysts at Unidanmark had on average forecast Denmark's foreign reserves to be unchanged in July from June. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33-969652
